summary: Light steel guyed lookout on Tower Road near Cloyne, Ontario; Oscar Lemke worked in it 1958-1972; no source says if it still stands.

facts.design: Light steel tower with guy wires and an octagonal cupola
facts.status_note: No source I read says whether the tower still stands.

events.note: Oscar Lemke worked in the tower from 1958 to 1972, per a photo caption in the 2026 newsletter.

notes_for_editor: No source here says whether the tower still stands or what is on the Tower Road site; the 2007 article's 'is(was) located' wording is the only hint. The Southern Ontario Fire Towers Map (ontfiretowersmap.yolasite.com), seen only in search snippets, is said to date the tower to 1922 at 80 ft; the site returned HTTP 403 to fetch_text and WebFetch, so that date and height are unverified and left out. Oscar Lemke's 1958-1972 dates come from a photo caption in the 2026 newsletter. The photo's image was not viewed; its file name and categories name the Myers Cave fire tower. Spelling varies: Myer's (Firelookout.ca, Commons) and Myers (newsletter). The brief has no local_unit for this tower; the Commons quote places it on North Frontenac Road 506.
